subject: Security onboarding: Highpoint SIG playbook & QA sync
messages:
From: Tara Brooks <tara@highpointhealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@highpointhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Security intake and next steps for Highpoint integration

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Highpoint's compliance team would like to kick off a short onboarding call to review the SIG/CaiQ questionnaire scope, confirm evidence owners, and get a checklist for log samples and retention controls.

We're aiming for a 30–45m session the week of Oct 4th. Can you share availability and the typical attendees from Redwood? Also—are there any pre-read artifacts you suggest we review so the call is productive?

Thanks,
Tara Brooks
Head of IT Risk, Highpoint Health
tara@highpointhealth.com | +1 415-555-0132

--
Highpoint Health

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Brooks <tara@highpointhealth.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@highpointhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake and next steps for Highpoint integration

Hi Tara — great to hear from you.

We can do a 30–45m SIG/CaiQ intake the week of Oct 4th. Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue 2026-10-05 10:00–10:45
- Wed 2026-10-06 14:00–14:45
- Thu 2026-10-07 09:00–09:45

Attendees from Redwood: me (security intake lead), Marissa (platform/ops for logs & infra), and Irene (compliance/SOC2 owner). If you expect procurement or legal to join, we can loop them in.

Pre-reads: attaching a brief "evidence playbook" and a small log sample extractor we commonly share. The playbook has the mapping from SIG questions to the typical artifacts (policies, diagrams, sample logs). Reviewing sections 1–3 will save time.

If you can confirm which questionnaire (SIG vs CAIQ vs both) and the priority areas (data residency, logging, access controls), we'll tailor the agenda.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Security Solutions, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: redwood-soc2-evidence-playbook-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
Attachment: logging-sample-agg-2026-09.txt (text sample)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Brooks <tara@highpointhealth.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@highpointhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake and next steps for Highpoint integration

Tara — quick note from a platform perspective.

On the call I'll cover:
- Where logs live (region-specific S3 buckets / retention policies)
- Typical log samples we can export (auth events, API request traces, system audit trails)
- How we generate sample anonymized logs for review (we use a scrub + aggregation flow)

If you need a live demo of log extraction, flag that and we can reserve extra time or schedule a separate ops walkthrough. Also: if you have specific control IDs in the SIG spreadsheet you want us to map, paste them in a reply and I'll pre-populate the playbook sheet.

Marissa Cole
Platform Ops, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: logging-sample-agg-2026-09.txt (sample aggregated logs, redacted)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Tara Brooks <tara@highpointhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake and next steps for Highpoint integration

Hi Tara — adding a short agenda and proposed owners so we can hit the ground running: 

Agenda (30–45m):
1) Introductions & scope (5m) — Nikhil / Tara
2) Questionnaire scope & priority controls (10m) — Tara / Irene
3) Evidence mapping walk-through (10m) — Irene / Marissa
4) Log samples, redaction approach, and handoff (10m) — Marissa
5) Next steps / timeline for artifacts (5m) — Nikhil

Proposed evidence owners (Redwood):
- SOC2 control artifacts, policies: Irene Choi
- Runtime logs & retention: Marissa Cole
- Architecture diagrams & network controls: Nikhil Sharma

Suggested pre-call ask for Highpoint: attach the SIG/CAIQ file you want mapped (or a short list of control IDs) and any must-have compliance constraints (e.g., data residency in us-east-1, contractual retention terms). If you prefer, we can review both SIG and CAIQ in the same session but focus on the highest-risk 10–15 controls.

I will also upload a populated worksheet to the Drive folder (link below) before the call.

Irene Choi
Lead, Compliance & SOC2, Redwood Inference
--
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBz-Highpoint-Onboarding
